findings.title: [P1] Restrict login redirects to trusted same-origin paths
findings.body: When `returnUrl` is attacker-controlled, passing it directly to `location.assign` permits external and potentially active-scheme URLs. This creates a realistic post-login phishing or script-execution path. Validate the target and allow only trusted same-origin paths.

findings.title: [P1] Stop logging issued authentication tokens
findings.body: `recordIssuedToken` sends the live token through `audit` to `console.log`. Deployments that retain or export console output therefore expose reusable bearer credentials to anyone with log access. Log only redacted, non-sensitive metadata.

findings.title: [P1] Stop logging issued authentication tokens
findings.body:
Calling `recordIssuedToken` with a live reusable token writes the credential verbatim to console output, exposing it to log collectors and anyone with log access, who can replay it until expiration.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Restrict login return URLs to trusted same-origin paths
findings.body:
Any caller-supplied absolute URL, such as `https://attacker.example`, now redirects the user off-site after login. If `returnUrl` originates from a request parameter, this creates an open redirect suitable for post-authentication phishing.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restrict login redirects to trusted same-origin URLs
findings.body:
If `returnUrl` is attacker-controlled, values such as `https://evil.example` create an open redirect, while `javascript:...` URLs can execute script in the application origin where browser policy permits, enabling credential or session theft.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Stop writing issued tokens to console logs
findings.body:
Every issued token is passed unredacted to `console.log`. In environments that retain or export console output, anyone with broader log access can recover bearer credentials and impersonate affected users until those tokens expire or are revoked.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
